question: Which function replaces matlab.addons.install?
answer:
Based on MATLAB R2026b, released 23 September 2026 [1][2]: `mpminstall` replaces `matlab.addons.install`, which has been marked "not recommended" since R2026b [4]. MathWorks says there are no plans to remove `matlab.addons.install`, but `mpminstall` offers more flexible options for installing and managing add-ons [4].

The documented replacements for the old calls are [4]:

```matlab
% Not recommended
installedAddon = matlab.addons.install("C:\Downloads\My toolbox.mltbx")
installedAddon = matlab.addons.install("C:\Downloads\My toolbox.mltbx","overwrite")
installedAddon = matlab.addons.install("C:\Downloads\My toolbox.mltbx","add")

% Recommended
installedAddon = mpminstall("C:\Downloads\My toolbox.mltbx")
installedAddon = mpminstall("C:\Downloads\My toolbox.mltbx",AllowVersionReplacement=true)
installedAddon = mpminstall("C:\Downloads\My toolbox.mltbx",AllowVersionReplacement=false)
```

Two related changes:
- The `agreeToLicense` argument is no longer supported. License agreement approval now happens by default [4].
- For uninstalling and listing add-ons, the release notes point to `mpmuninstall` and `mpmlist` [3].
